description: This PHP class 'PartialClaimAttachment' in the 'OrangeHRM' project defines a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent an attachment related to partial claims within the Claim module. It encapsulates properties like request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, file type, the user who added the attachment, and its attached date. The class also includes methods for getting and setting these properties and interacts with other entities such as Employee and ClaimRequest.

classes.name: PartialClaimAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing an attachment for partial claims, including properties such as request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, file type, added by user, and attached date. It leverages multiple traits to incorporate helper methods and entity management functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing all properties of the DTO, including fetching the employee who added the attachment via a reference method.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the related claim request.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the related claim request.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment ID.

methods.name: setAttachId

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize

methods.name: setDescription

methods.name: getFilename

methods.name: setFilename
